questions.question: Sipho scored 17 out of 20. Write his score as a percentage and explain how.
questions.expected_answer: Change 17/20 into hundredths by multiplying the top and bottom by 5: 17/20 = 85/100. 85/100 is 85%.

questions.question: Write 40% and 35% as fractions in simplest form.
questions.expected_answer: 40% = 40/100, which simplifies to 2/5 when you divide the top and bottom by 20; and 35% = 35/100, which simplifies to 7/20 when you divide the top and bottom by 5.

questions.question: Find 15% of R360 using 10% first.
questions.expected_answer: 10% of R360 is R36. 5% is half of that, R18. So 15% is R36 + R18 = R54.
